title: Version 1.58.0
html:
Version 1.58.0 (👀 The Buildin' And Showin' Update!)

June 15th, 2024

Added:

  • The new Blueprint Fabricator is here, a way to create blueprint prefabs that you can place all at once
  • Rewrote the entire building UI, this also introduces a few new building features, as well as more to come soon
  • Added the ability to rate bases with stars, this can be accessed via property signs outside of bases
  • Added the ability to customize your property sign with unlocked signs via stars, or Robux!
  • Added Group Rewards, redeeming this will grant you $2,000 & an exclusive TD property sign
  • Added Follower Rewards, redeeming this will grant you an Avatar Trophy & a Developer property sign

Changed:

  • Possible fix for disappearing items on Console and Mobile platforms
  • Lowered the price of the Extendable Ladder

Fixes:

  • Misc Bug Fixes 🐛

Version 1.58.1

June 15th, 2024

Changed:

  • Player statues no-longer have clothing attached to them (t-shirts are an exception)
  • Removed random part on the map

Version 1.58.2

June 15th, 2024

Changed:

  • Player statues no longer have any 2D clothes, and layered clothing now turns gold aswell.
  • Statues no longer have wonky behavior with where they face and stand on the pedestals.

Version 1.58.3

June 15th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Player's can no-longer steal schematic designs from other players
  • Fixed ATM interactions showing random owners
  • Fixed Sign interactions showing random owners

Version 1.58.4

June 15th, 2024

Changed:

  • Avatar Statues now properly color and materialize all dynamic heads and layered clothing (even when color is baked into the mesh...)
